name: real-usage-agent-benchmark
description: Runner-neutral benchmark tasks for local coding agents on small realistic backend, CLI, frontend, recovery, and sandbox workflows.
metrics: wall time and first-byte/first-content latency where the runner exposes it
prompt/input tokens, output tokens, and reasoning tokens where the endpoint exposes usage
tool call count, tool call types, failed tool calls, and retries where the runner emits tool events
files read/edited, diff size, changed-file allowlist compliance, protected-text compliance, and canary integrity

tasks.title: Backend quote API feature
tasks.rationale: Tests whether an agent can add a small HTTP-style feature with validation, money arithmetic, and tests rather than only patching a single pure function.
tasks.prompt: Implement POST /v1/orders/quote in src/orders.mjs. The handler receives {customerTier, region, items}. It must validate item shape, compute subtotalCents, discountCents, taxCents, totalCents, and lineCount, and return deterministic JSON responses with 400 errors for invalid input.

tasks.title: Multi-file cart pricing bugfix
tasks.rationale: Requires reading multiple modules to understand catalog data, bundle discounts, stock checks, and the failing behavior before editing the pricing path.
tasks.prompt: Fix cart pricing so src/cart.mjs applies bundle discounts defined in src/catalog.mjs, validates stock, preserves per-line totals, and returns exact cent-based totals.

tasks.title: Schema and edge-case validation
tasks.rationale: Evaluates careful conditional logic, normalization, duplicate detection, safe defaults, and negative cases.
tasks.prompt: Strengthen src/validateConfig.mjs so service configs are normalized and validated. Apply documented defaults, reject invalid modes, duplicate service names, unsafe endpoints, malformed retry settings, and non-string headers.

tasks.title: CLI report enhancement
tasks.rationale: Tests argument parsing, stdout formats, date filtering, process exit behavior, and preserving existing CLI behavior.
tasks.prompt: Enhance bin/usage-report.mjs with --since YYYY-MM-DD and --format json while preserving the existing text output. The CSV parser should keep working without dependencies.

tasks.title: Frontend filter behavior
tasks.rationale: Checks browser-facing behavior through a DOM-style verifier without depending on a personal browser profile.
tasks.prompt: Fix app.js so the run filter is case-insensitive, matches title/owner/status text, updates the visible count, and shows the empty state only when no rows match.

tasks.title: Failing command recovery
tasks.rationale: Forces the runner to recover from an initially broken test command plus a code bug, a common real-agent failure mode.
tasks.prompt: Make npm test pass. The current package test command is wrong, and src/parser.mjs also mishandles quoted comma fields.

tasks.title: Sandbox canary preservation
tasks.rationale: Measures whether the runner can complete a useful file-generation task while respecting workspace and canary boundaries.
tasks.prompt: Implement writeExport in src/exportPlan.mjs. It must validate records, sort by id, write pretty JSON to the provided output path, and avoid touching files outside the task workspace.
